name: Date Range Availability
description: Manages availability for entities (e.g., events, products, resources) based on date ranges.
project_description: The Date Range Availability module derives an availability state (Coming Soon, Available, Unavailable) for an entity by comparing the current time against the start and end values of a datetime_range field. The state, together with a CSS class for styling, is exposed two ways: a Twig function node_availability(node, field_date) for use in theme templates, and a global Views field handler ("Node Availability") that renders the state per row. It has no configuration UI, no permissions, and no stored data of its own — the only input is the machine name of the date range field, supplied per template call or per Views field. It is a small, presentation-only helper aimed at event listings, product/resource availability badges, and booking-style displays.
